answer: Proof of stake acts as a karst of capital, eroding the feasibility of cheap identity proliferation by requiring agents to lock assets. Like an ember igniting a network, the stake creates a barrier where every validator’s weight is bounded by financial skin in the game. This architecture traps sybil nodes in a lagoon of insolvency, as multiplying accounts forces the attacker to disperse limited funds, ensuring that the cost of control always exceeds the marginal utility of any singular fake identity.
